1343.1.1.description:
Power up DUTs and make sure an n-stack forms properly.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a VCS stack forms cleanly from a cold power-up of all DUTs, with every member joining and reaching READY state, agreeing on interface status, and with stack ports up.

1343.1.2.description:
Perform rolling reboot on n-stack and check whether stack reforms.

[Log-derived analysis] Performs a rolling reboot of the VCS stack (rebooting the master and waiting for backup members to rejoin) and verifies the stack reforms with all members reaching READY state, running-config preserved after teardown, and no exceptions or core dumps.

1343.1.3.description:
Booting up n-stack by staggered power up

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a VCS stack forms correctly when its members are powered up in a staggered sequence rather than simultaneously. Confirms all members join the stack and reach READY state with stack ports and interface status consistent across members.

1343.1.4.description:
Reboot whole n-stack 3 times and make sure stack reforms after each reboot.

[Log-derived analysis] Reboots the entire VCS stack repeatedly and verifies the stack reforms after every reboot, with all members rejoining READY state and no exceptions.

1343.1.5.description:
Reboot each backup member in sequence and check whether stack reforms after each reboot.

[Log-derived analysis] Reboots each backup member of the VCS stack in turn and verifies that the stack reforms after each member returns, with all members rejoining READY state.

1343.1.6.description:
Stack formation check after rebooting one backup member then another one after 20 seconds.

[Log-derived analysis] Reboots one backup member and then a second backup member a short time later, verifying the VCS stack reforms with all members rejoining READY state.

1343.1.7.description:
Stack formation check after power cycling three backup members simultaneously. 4 <= n <= 8

[Log-derived analysis] Power-cycles three backup members of the VCS stack simultaneously and verifies the stack reforms with all members rejoining READY state.

1343.1.8.description:
Stack formation check after a member recovers from disabled master due to incompatible SW.

[Inferred behavior — no execution history for this case] Loads incompatible software onto a member so it is disabled by the master, then verifies that after the member recovers (correct software resynced) the VCS stack reforms with all members rejoining READY state.

1343.1.9.description:
Stack formation check after power cycling a joining member after insertion event.

[Log-derived analysis] Power-cycles a joining member immediately after an insertion event and verifies the VCS stack forms correctly with the member rejoining and all members reaching READY state.

1343.1.10.description:
Stack formation check after power cycling a joining member during synchronisation.

[Log-derived analysis] Power-cycles a member while it is synchronising into the VCS stack and verifies the stack still forms correctly once the member completes joining, with all members reaching READY state.

1343.1.11.description:
Stack formation check after rolling reboot during synchronisation following a failover.

[Log-derived analysis] Triggers a master failover and then performs a rolling reboot during the resynchronisation window, verifying the stack still reforms correctly with all members rejoining and no exceptions occurring.

1343.1.12.description:
Stack formation check after a member recovers from disabled master due to incompatible SW.

[Log-derived analysis] Loads incompatible software onto a member so it is disabled by the master, then verifies that after the member recovers (correct software resynced) the VCS stack reforms with all members rejoining READY state.

1343.1.13.description:
Stack formation check after power cycling a joining member during synchronisation.

[Log-derived analysis] Power-cycles a member while it is synchronising into the VCS stack and verifies the stack still forms correctly once the member completes joining, with all members reaching READY state.

1343.1.21.description:
Perform rolling reboot on n-stack, upgrade and downgrade between previous release and current build.

[Log-derived analysis] Performs a rolling reboot of the VCS stack while upgrading and downgrading between the previous release and the current build, verifying the stack reforms cleanly after each transition with all members rejoining, the running-config preserved, and no exceptions.

1343.1.22.description:
Test software auto synchronisation.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies VCS software auto-synchronisation: a member booting with a different software build is automatically synced to the master's release so the stack forms with consistent software across all members reaching READY state.

1343.1.101.description:
Reboot the DUTs and make sure the stack forms properly.

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that a VCS stack reforms correctly after the DUTs are rebooted, confirming all members rejoin and reach READY state with consistent interface and stack-port status.

1343.1.67405.description:
Resiliency link status, vlan4093

[Log-derived analysis] Configures VCS resiliency links between stack members and verifies that every member reports the resiliency link status as Successful or Configured, confirming the dedicated resiliency (stand-by) link is healthy on the management VLAN.

1343.1.75761.description:
Perform rolling reboot on n-stack with LAGs and check whether stack reforms.

[Log-derived analysis] Performs a rolling reboot of the VCS stack with static LAGs configured and verifies the stack reforms after each reboot with all members rejoining READY state, LAG/channel-group state intact, and no exceptions.

1343.1.80760.description:
VCS+ duplicate master after rebooting line cards

[Inferred behavior — case reported UNSUPPORTED on the current test setup; no recent PASS] Intended to verify that rebooting line cards in a VCS+ chassis stack does not produce a duplicate-master (split-brain) condition, confirming a single Active Master is maintained and the stack stays healthy.

1343.1.674050.description:
Resiliency link status, vlan1000

[Log-derived analysis] Configures VCS resiliency links between stack members and verifies that every member reports the resiliency link status as Successful or Configured, confirming the dedicated resiliency (stand-by) link is healthy on the management VLAN.
